$comment: Read by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs in CI. Baselines are gzip level 9 of a production build of main @ 63f2fbc (v1.0.0, before /room), built on Linux as CI builds: node 22.13 + pnpm 9.15.4 from a clean install. The same code builds about 500-600 B smaller on macOS, so a local run understates growth; CI's figure is the one that counts. Raise a baseline only in the PR that grows the bundle on purpose, and say why there.

panel.$comment: Everything /panel loads: the main JS plus the panel page's chunk and its static imports.
